Since ASVS version v4.0.3 we take translation only in markdown. All other formats we need to be able to generate out of that.

https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md

Arabic translation pdf file got accepted (#1172, #1173), but we can not create any other format (csv, json, ...) from this.
